title: Images as tensors
description: Pixels, channels, HWC vs CHW layout, uint8 vs float, normalisation and standardisation, colour spaces and grayscale.

title: Image filters by convolution
description: Sliding a small kernel over an image: blur, Sobel edges, histograms, output size.

title: Image augmentation
description: Label-preserving random transforms (flip, crop, jitter) and mixup, and what invariance each teaches.

title: Image classification pipeline and top-k evaluation
description: Logits, cross-entropy, top-1/top-5 accuracy, confusion matrix and the training loop invariants.

title: Transfer learning and fine-tuning
description: Frozen features, linear probes, fine-tuning, discriminative and layer-wise learning rates, BatchNorm pitfalls.

title: Bounding boxes, IoU and non-maximum suppression
description: Box formats, intersection over union, greedy NMS and its threshold.

title: Single-shot object detection
description: Grid and anchors, output tensor layout, box decoding, objectness, detection loss terms.

title: Detection metrics and mean average precision
description: Matching detections to ground truth, precision-recall curves, average precision, mAP at IoU thresholds.

title: Semantic segmentation and U-Net
description: Pixel-wise classification, encoder-decoder with skip connections, shapes through the U.

title: Dice and IoU for masks
description: Overlap metrics and losses for class-imbalanced segmentation, mean IoU from a confusion matrix.

title: Instance segmentation and RoIAlign
description: Mask R-CNN as detection plus a mask head, bilinear sampling of region features without rounding.

title: Patch embedding and vision transformers
description: Cutting an image into patches, linear projection to tokens, class token, token counts and attention cost.

title: Contrastive self-supervised learning (NT-Xent)
description: Two augmented views, cosine similarity with temperature, the NT-Xent loss, DINO teacher-student idea.

title: CLIP and zero-shot vision-language models
description: Two-tower encoders, symmetric InfoNCE with temperature, zero-shot classification by prompts, retrieval, limits.
